title: 4 Days Fly-In & Fly-Out Serengeti Experience
description: This 4-day Fly-In & Fly-Out Serengeti Focus Safari is designed for travelers who want a pure Serengeti wildlife experience without road transfers. The journey begins with a scenic flight from Zanzibar or Arusha to the remote Northern Serengeti, followed by intensive game drives in prime wildlife areas. A full day is dedicated to following the Great Migration around the Mara River, before continuing to the wildlife-rich Central Serengeti. The safari concludes with a final game drive and a return flight to Zanzibar or Arusha, delivering an unforgettable Serengeti adventure.
highlights: Fly-in & fly-out safari from Zanzibar or Arusha
Northern Serengeti exploration, famous for the Great Migration
Full-day Mara River experience (seasonal river crossings)
Outstanding predator sightings in Northern and Central Serengeti
Explore Central Serengeti (Seronera), rich in year-round wildlife
Unlimited game drives with a professional safari guide
No long road transfers – maximum time on safari
excludes: Optional activities (e.g. hot air balloon safari )

itinerary.title: Fly to Northern Serengeti
itinerary.text: Take a scenic flight from Zanzibar or Arusha to Northern Serengeti, where your professional safari guide meets you at the airstrip and begins a game drive immediately. Spend the afternoon exploring open plains and riverine areas with excellent chances to see elephants, giraffes, buffaloes, lions, leopards, and large herds of plains game. Overnight in Northern Serengeti.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Mara River Experience (Northern Serengeti)
itinerary.text: Enjoy a full day of game drives around the Mara River, focusing on the Great Migration (seasonal). Track wildebeest and zebra herds near river crossing points, observe crocodiles and hippos, and watch predator activity along the riverbanks and surrounding plains. This is one of the most dramatic wildlife spectacles in Africa.

itinerary.title: Northern Serengeti to Central Serengeti
itinerary.text: After breakfast, depart Northern Serengeti with an en-route game drive toward Central Serengeti. Wildlife sightings continue across the vast plains. Upon arrival in the Seronera area, game drives focus on predator-rich zones around rivers and kopjes, home to lions, cheetahs, leopards, elephants, and abundant resident wildlife.

itinerary.title: Central Serengeti Game Drive & Fly Out
itinerary.text: Start the day with a morning game drive in Central Serengeti during peak wildlife activity. After the game drive, transfer to the airstrip and fly back to Arusha or Zanzibar, marking the end of a memorable Serengeti-focused safari.

summary: This 4-day Fly-In & Fly-Out Serengeti Focus Safari is designed for travelers who want a pure Serengeti wildlife experience without road transfers.
